verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents its own session recordings: rrweb DOM/interaction replays and MP4 video, explicitly positioned for debugging failures. That covers the replay and video parts of the story. The screenshot mentions are scrape/fetch output formats, not debugging artifacts of an agent run. Nothing shows a step-by-step agent action timeline. missing for 10: per-step screenshots of agent runs, step-by-step agent action/reasoning timeline, independent or hands-on corroboration of debugging with replays.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can debug a failed agent run from recorded replays — video, screenshots, step-by-step action timelines

citations.quote: Record and replay your browser sessions to debug failures, analyze behavior, and share reproducible bug reports.
Hyperbrowser supports both web recordings (using rrweb) that capture DOM changes and interactions in a lightweight format, and traditional MP4 video recordings for easy sharing.
